name: conditions

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/30 * * * *'

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: install
        run: |
          pip install ecmwf-opendata cfgrib xarray numpy pillow eccodes
          python -m cfgrib selfcheck

      - name: build PNG
        run: python make_conditions.py

      - name: commit
        run: |
          git config user.name "smoggy-bot"
          git config user.email "bot@smoggyapp.com"

          # AUTO: panta stage. An ftasame edo, to "build PNG" step idi
          # petyxe (an skoupsei PRAGMATIKA -- oxi "not ready yet" -- to
          # script exit != 0, kai auto to step den trexei kan -- default
          # GitHub Actions symperifora, kamia allagi xreiazetai edo).
          git add conditions/auto

          # Alex 28/08/26 (polling redesign): to .last_auto_run kratai poio
          # itan to teleftaio epityximeno AUTO cycle -- to make_conditions.py
          # to xrisimopoiei gia na ypologisei to EPOMENO (+6h), MIDEN
          # manteuma/offset piа. Den yparxei se "not ready yet" tick (den
          # egrapse tipota neo) -- to "|| true" apotrepei na skasei to step.
          git add .last_auto_run || true

          # FORECAST: stage MONO se rita "success". Se opoiodipote allo
          # status (failure / unrecovered / missing file) -> checkout piso
          # sto HEAD PRIN apo opoiodipote add, ostu o,ti mess emeine ston
          # ephemeral disk na MIN ftasei pote se commit.
          status=$(cat .forecast_status 2>/dev/null || echo "failure")
          if [ "$status" = "success" ]; then
            git add conditions/forecast
          else
            git checkout -- conditions/forecast 2>/dev/null || true
            echo "::warning:: forecast status=$status - conditions/forecast reset to HEAD, not committed"
          fi

          git commit -m "conditions" || echo "no change"
          git push || echo "nothing to push"
